cohort: 1,875,322 term, singleton live births without congenital anomalies in Canada (excluding Quebec) from 2003 to 2010
finding: Neonatal readmission rates were lowest following a 1-2 day stay after vaginal birth and a 2-4 day stay after cesarean birth.
mod_finding: Readmissions were lowest following a 1-2-day stay following a vaginal birth and a 2-4-day stay following a cesarean birth.
